text: Free arcade flying demo: flips, barrel rolls and drifts, at full speed.
Blast targets and weave through the terrain before the mission timer runs out.
Between missions you upgrade your weapons, then head to another planet.
Best moment in the trailer: flying upside down through a tight canyon.
The catch? The landscapes look a bit empty, and the HUD takes up a lot of screen.
The Windows demo is about four hundred megabytes, in nine languages.
Think Star Fox, with more drifting.
Worth a dip if you miss arcade flyers.
